# t2 — Source Analysis & Target Spring MVC Architecture

## Summary
Complete analysis of the Struts 1.3 SkiShop monolith and target Spring Boot 3.2 / Spring MVC architecture design. Covers all layers: controllers, services, DAOs, domain model, security, JSP view integration, and configuration.

## Deliverables
- [t2-architect-source-analysis.md](./t2-architect-source-analysis.md) — Source codebase analysis (project structure, tech stack, data model, service layer, session management)
- [t2-architect-target-architecture.md](./t2-architect-target-architecture.md) — Target Spring MVC architecture design (controllers, security config, JSP migration, DI wiring, URL routing)
- [t2-architect-migration-risks.md](./t2-architect-migration-risks.md) — Risk register with severity and mitigation for each migration concern
